# Scheduled notification acceptance

This fixture uses only its own bundle ID, notification center and data directory. Build from the repository root with `go tool nsgo build -target macos_arm64,ios,android_arm64 -output /tmp/schedulednotifications internal/testhost/testdata/schedulednotifications`; add `-profile <development-profile>` for the iPhone’s signed package. Rebuild Android’s runtime from the Java under test before packaging, following `docs/public/en/contributing.md`; leave those runtime binaries out of the pull request.

Open the app and choose **Schedule owned notifications**, allowing only this fixture’s notifications. On Apple, `-phase=schedule` also starts the scenario, and `-phase=inspect` writes the identifiers and titles of this fixture’s pending and delivered notifications to `inspect.txt`. Four accepted requests produce `schedule.txt` in `core.Scope.DataDir()`: `deliver1356` is due in one minute, `move1356` moves from one minute to ninety seconds with a new title, and `cancel1356` is cancelled before its one-minute deadline. Wait for the accepted report before killing the app’s processes. On Android, use a process kill rather than force-stop, which intentionally disables alarms until the next launch.

At the first deadline, only the delivery notification should show. The moved notification shows at its later deadline, with **NSGo 1356 moved** as its title, and the cancelled one never shows. Pressing one while the app is stopped must start it and write that complete ID to `press.txt`. Android inexact alarms may arrive later within their platform window; compare the notification manager’s posting time and the alarm manager’s window instead of assuming second-level precision.

On a disposable Android emulator, repeat with `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` granted and denied, under Doze, and across a reboot before the deadline. Confirm exact alarms have a zero window when granted, inexact allow-while-idle alarms otherwise, the moved and cancelled schedules remain correct after boot, and no Go process needs to be running for delivery. Never reboot a shared device for this fixture. On Windows use a signed-in desktop session; cold-start press acceptance also needs the installer’s Start menu shortcut. Use **Clear owned notifications** and uninstall this fixture when finished.
